description: Files a bug report or feature request with the Sergio team. It lands in the team's one Feedback inbox, the same place the in-app help bubble's reports go, tagged with this agent seat, and the team is notified the moment it is filed. There is no other feedback channel to try. Check with your user first unless they have already told you that you may report without asking; afterwards, tell your user in one line what you sent. Never include passwords, API keys, or card numbers.
name: report_feedback
title: Report a bug or idea to the Sergio team
